payload.reason: The sensitivity study was conducted to evaluate the effects of not considering the remineralization of biomass on carbon storage and nutrient dynamics in the ocean.

claims.text: The sensitivity study was conducted without considering remineralization to assess the permanent storage of carbon captured by MOS.
Not accounting for remineralization leads to a long-term nutrient decline in surface layers, affecting primary net primary production (PNPP).
The study aimed to explore the potential for increased carbon dioxide removal (CDR) by avoiding the effects of remineralization on benthic oxygen minimum zones (OMZs).
